name: MorphingBorder
description: Container framed by a traveling conic outline whose perimeter gradient, corner geometry, and orbit velocity morph smoothly with a static-border fallback.
a11yNotes: Uses a purely decorative perimeter layer marked aria-hidden='true' and falls back to a crisp 1px static border under prefers-reduced-motion.
